decisions.name: Decision_Path
decisions.label: Which Path?
decisions.description: Branches on the radio button the user selected. Only two outcomes exist, so the Existing Investing Entity path is carried by the default connector rather than by a second rule, keeping the canvas to one trunk and two branches. Hidden sections are nullified when the screen advances, so values typed into the branch NOT chosen can never leak into the branch that runs.

decisions.name: Decision_State_Requires_Country
decisions.label: State Without Country?
decisions.description: Guards the New Investing Entity path against a Tax Address that has a State selected but no Country, because Tax_Address__StateCode__s cannot be saved without Tax_Address__CountryCode__s (FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION). This lives here as a Decision rather than as a validationRule on Picklist_Tax_State because DropdownBox screen fields do not support validation rules at all. Runs before Get_Entity_By_Name so nothing is queried or created on input that cannot save.

decisions.name: Decision_Duplicate_Name
decisions.label: Duplicate Entity Name?
decisions.description: Checks whether an Investing Entity Account already exists with the entered name. No Tax ID duplicate check is performed because Tax_ID__c is Encrypted Text and cannot be filtered in SOQL.

decisions.name: Decision_Entity_Selected
decisions.label: Entity Selected?
decisions.description: Checks whether the user actually picked an Investing Entity in the Lookup component before continuing. The component exposes its selection as Lookup_Investing_Entity.recordId, never as a bare field name.

decisions.name: Decision_Valid_Entity
decisions.label: Valid Investing Entity?
decisions.description: Confirms the Account picked via the unfiltered Lookup component is actually an Investing Entity record type. Required because the Lookup can technically return any Account, so this Decision is the only backstop.

decisions.name: Decision_ACR_Exists
decisions.label: Already Related?
decisions.description: Blocks a duplicate AccountContactRelation between this Contact and the selected Investing Entity. This also covers the case where the user picks the Contact's OWN primary Account: Salesforce auto-creates a direct relation for that pairing, so Get_Existing_ACR finds it and this rule stops the insert that the platform would reject anyway.

decisions.name: Decision_Required_Signer
decisions.label: Required Signer?
decisions.description: If the user checked Required Signer, checks for a Signing Order conflict before creating the relationship; otherwise proceeds straight to creation with a blank Signing Order.

decisions.name: Decision_Signing_Order_In_Use
decisions.label: Signing Order In Use?
decisions.description: Checks whether another AccountContactRelation on this Investing Entity already uses the entered Signing Order. No equivalent check is needed on the New Investing Entity path because a brand new Account has no relationships yet, so Signing Order 1 cannot collide.

Flow.description: Relates an existing investor Contact to an Investing Entity Account from the Contact record page. Launched by the Manage Investing Entity quick action, which passes the Contact Id into the recordId input variable. Two paths: create a brand new Investing Entity (the Contact becomes Primary Contact and a Required Signer with Signing Order 1), or select an existing one (Primary Contact false, with Required Signer and Signing Order chosen by the user). The AccountContactRelation is created directly; this flow never creates a Contact and never changes the Contact's own Account. No Tax ID duplicate check is performed because Account.Tax_ID__c is Encrypted Text and cannot be filtered in SOQL.
Flow.label: Manage Investing Entity

recordCreates.name: Create_Account_Entity
recordCreates.label: Create Account (New Entity)
recordCreates.description: Creates the new Investing Entity Account. The five Tax Address assignments write to the compound field's subfields; State and Country use the *Code__s variants because State and Country Picklists are enabled on this org and the plain subfield forms do not exist on custom compound address fields.

recordCreates.name: Create_ACR_New_Entity
recordCreates.label: Create Relationship (New Entity)
recordCreates.description: Relates the context Contact to the Account just created, with the defaults promised on screen: Primary Contact, Required Signer, Signing Order 1. Created directly rather than retrieved, because the Contact already exists and no Contact insert happens here to auto-create a relationship. Its fault path rolls back first so a failure here cannot leave an orphaned Account behind.

recordCreates.name: Create_ACR_Existing_Entity
recordCreates.label: Create Relationship (Existing Entity)
recordCreates.description: Relates the context Contact to the Investing Entity the user picked. Primary Contact is always false on this path; that designation is reserved for the Contact the entity was created with. Signing Order arrives blank whenever Required Signer is unchecked, because hidden screen components are nullified when the screen advances. This is the only DML on this path, so no rollback element is needed on its fault route.

recordLookups.name: Get_RT_Investing_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get RT Investing Entity
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Id of the Account.Investing_Entity record type, needed both to stamp the new Account and to validate the Account picked on the existing entity path.

recordLookups.name: Get_Context_Contact
recordLookups.label: Get Context Contact
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Contact the quick action was launched from, using the recordId input variable. Only Id and Name are queried; Name is used to make the success and error messages name the person rather than say "this Contact".

recordLookups.name: Get_Entity_By_Name
recordLookups.label: Get Entity By Name
recordLookups.description: Checks for an existing Investing Entity Account with the entered name, scoped to the Investing_Entity record type only so an Account of a different record type with the same name is not treated as a duplicate.

recordLookups.name: Get_Selected_Entity
recordLookups.label: Get Selected Entity
recordLookups.description: Re-fetches the Account picked via the Lookup component to confirm it is an Investing Entity record type, and to get its Name for the confirmation and error messages.

recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_ACR
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Relationship
recordLookups.description: Looks for an AccountContactRelation that already links this Contact to the selected Investing Entity, covering both indirect relationships created by this flow and the direct one Salesforce auto-creates for the Contact's own primary Account.

recordLookups.name: Get_ACR_By_Signing_Order
recordLookups.label: Get Relationship By Signing Order
recordLookups.description: Checks whether another AccountContactRelation on the selected Investing Entity already uses the entered Signing Order. Reached only when Required Signer is checked, so Input_Signing_Order is always populated here.

recordRollbacks.name: Roll_Back_Records
recordRollbacks.label: Roll Back Records
recordRollbacks.description: Rolls back all pending DML in this transaction. Reached only from Create_ACR_New_Entity's fault path, which is the one place in this flow where a failure could otherwise leave a committed Account with no relationship attached. It must run BEFORE Screen_Error_General, because reaching any Screen commits everything pending.

screens.name: Screen_Manage_Entity
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: The single input screen. A required radio with no preselected value chooses the path, and the two sections below it show or hide against that radio, so the user never sees fields belonging to the other path. Deliberately one screen rather than a wizard: every error screen sets allowBack=true, so Back returns here with the entries retained.

fields.name: Radio_Path
fields.fieldText: How would you like to proceed?

fields.name: DisplayText_New_Entity_Defaults
fields.fieldText: This Contact will automatically be set as the Primary Contact and a Required Signer for the new Investing Entity, with Signing Order 1.

validationRule.errorMessage: Signing Order is required when this contact is a required signer.

screens.name: Screen_Success_New
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Confirms the new Investing Entity Account and its relationship to this Contact were created successfully.

fields.name: Success_New_Message
fields.fieldText:
Investing Entity "{!Input_Entity_Name}" has been created successfully.
{!rec_Contact.Name} is its Primary Contact and a Required Signer, with Signing Order 1.

screens.name: Screen_Success_Existing
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Confirms this Contact was related to the selected existing Investing Entity.

fields.name: Success_Existing_Message
fields.fieldText: {!rec_Contact.Name} has been related to the Investing Entity "{!rec_SelectedEntity.Name}" successfully.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Duplicate_Name
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when an Investing Entity Account already exists with the entered name. allowBack=true so the user can return to the input screen and either rename or switch to the existing entity path.

fields.name: Error_Duplicate_Name_Message
fields.fieldText: An Investing Entity named "{!Input_Entity_Name}" already exists. Please choose a different name, or go back and select the existing entity instead.

screens.name: Screen_Error_State_No_Country
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the Tax Address has a State selected but no Country. Reached from Decision_State_Requires_Country, which carries this guard because DropdownBox screen fields cannot carry validation rules.

fields.name: Error_State_No_Country_Message
fields.fieldText: Please select a Country for the Tax Address, or clear the State selection.

screens.name: Screen_Error_No_Entity
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the user chose the Existing Investing Entity path but did not pick one.

fields.name: Error_No_Entity_Message
fields.fieldText: Please select an Investing Entity to continue, or go back and choose a different option.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Invalid_Entity
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the Account picked via the unfiltered Lookup component is not an Investing Entity record type.

fields.name: Error_Invalid_Entity_Message
fields.fieldText: The selected record is not a valid Investing Entity. Please search again.

screens.name: Screen_Error_ACR_Exists
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when this Contact is already related to the selected Investing Entity, including the case where the user picked the Contact's own primary Account.

fields.name: Error_ACR_Exists_Message
fields.fieldText: {!rec_Contact.Name} is already related to the Investing Entity "{!rec_SelectedEntity.Name}". Please select a different Investing Entity.

screens.name: Screen_Error_Signing_Order
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an error when the entered Signing Order is already used by another signer on this Investing Entity.

fields.name: Error_Signing_Order_Message
fields.fieldText: This Signing Order is already in use on "{!rec_SelectedEntity.Name}". Please choose a different number.

screens.name: Screen_Error_General
screens.label: Manage Investing Entity
screens.description: Displays an unexpected fault message from any lookup or create in this flow. allowBack is false here, unlike the input correction error screens, because a fault means the transaction state is unknown and re-submitting from the same entries is not safe.

fields.name: Error_General_Message
fields.fieldText:
Error: An unexpected error occurred.
{!$Flow.FaultMessage}
